meta.notes: All px anchors are extension-line / tick positions detected on the source raster. Values are the printed annotation numbers. dimension annotation > raster pixel position.

chains.notes: Outer horizontal chain along the top. All four numbers legible. Datum = west exterior wall axis at px~163 (X=2800 in world).
Inner chain. Groups close to outer chain: 1000+3100+1000=5100, 1000+900=1900, 700+1800+700=3200, 700+1900+700=3300. Final 100mm segment terminates ~px528 (building outer face).

Outer horizontal chain along the bottom. Total 16300mm. Left datum at px86.5 does NOT coincide with any wall face - first 1400 segment reaches the west balcony railing (px124). The right end px526.5 lands on the main east wall inner face, ~2px inside the drawn outer face (px528.5).

Inner chain is offset +400mm vs outer (datum px97 instead of px86.5); its ticks coincide with outer ticks at px124/162/242/299/394/501. Last two printed values are clipped/unreadable at raster resolution; px evidence suggests a residual ~320mm to px527 and a possible further ~200-400mm beyond. Recorded as UNKNOWN per no-guess rule.

Inner vertical chain on the right side, read top->bottom. Segments 2100+3000+1400+1900+2200+1800+500 = 12900 = the outer total. Leading 1000+700 and trailing 700 measure the AC-bay / jog offsets outside the main 12900 envelope.

Overall vertical dimension 12900 from the north silhouette datum (px331) to the main south face (px684.5). The north datum corresponds to the top edge of the NE AC-bay structure, not to a clear wall face - see ISSUE-006.
